tools.name: score_opportunity
tools.description: Estimate risk-adjusted expected profit and margin for one opportunity before execution. Use it as an economics screen, not as proof that funding, escrow, requirements, or buyer legitimacy are valid. It is read-only and returns expectedProfit, margin, and eligibility using ARN's current minimums.

tools.name: route_provider
tools.description: Rank the provider candidates supplied in this call using quality, reliability, price, and latency, while excluding unhealthy or over-budget entries. Use only when you already have comparable provider metrics; this tool does not discover providers or verify the supplied measurements. It is read-only.

tools.name: json_normalize
tools.description: Recursively sort JSON object keys to produce stable structure and a deterministic JSON string. Use for comparisons, cache keys, repeatable payloads, or pre-signing preparation; do not use as RFC 8785/JCS canonicalization. This MCP call is read-only and does not charge: it returns the x402 endpoint a

tools.name: object_contract_check
tools.description: Check one JSON object's top-level required fields, allowed fields, and declared field types. Prefer this for new API/pipeline shape contracts; it is intentionally smaller and easier to reason about than full JSON Schema. This MCP call is read-only and returns x402 execution instructions without char

tools.name: json_schema_check
tools.description: Validate one JSON object when the caller already has a JSON-Schema-shaped contract. Only top-level required, properties.<field>.type, and additionalProperties=false are evaluated; for new simple contracts prefer object_contract_check. This MCP call is read-only and returns x402 execution instruction

tools.name: dataset_profile
tools.description: Discover deterministic data-quality profiling for 1-5,000 JSON-object rows. Paid execution counts field presence, missing and null values, observed primitive types, primitive cardinality and exact duplicate rows without modifying input; use schema_infer to draft a flat-record contract or tabular_val

tools.name: verified_translation

tools.name: result_dedupe

tools.name: tabular_diff

Paid execution reports added and removed keys plus changed rows with field-level evidence while preserving deterministic order; CSV or spreadsheet rows must be converted to JSON first. tools.name: tabular_validate
tools.description: Discover deterministic pre-import validation for JSON-record tables, including CSV or spreadsheet rows converted to JSON. Paid execution checks every row for required columns and declared primitive types and returns bounded row-and-field errors; use object_contract_check for one object or json_schem
